CustomField.description: The current step with a coloured flag, so it stands out: orange while waiting, green when approved, red when rejected or invalidated.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(Current_Step__c, "Rejected"), ISPICKVAL(Current_Step__c, "Invalidated")), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_red.gif", ""), IF(ISPICKVAL(Current_Step__c, "Approved"), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", ""), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_yellow.gif", ""))) & " " & UPPER(TEXT(Current_Step__c))
CustomField.label: AM Step
